author: KevineCove
body:
The "enemy joins mid battle" system introduced in the new Riftfall is terrible and I'm not going to mince words about it. What's the meaningful difference of it compared to just having a dungeon with more floors? Fighting enemies that give no rewards that you can't codex? Not being done with a fight until RNG says so?

There are a million features worth adding to Orna, this wasn't one of them.
